next_experiments.title: sharpening tie-break
next_experiments.hypothesis: sharpening at 0.15 to 0.25 produces a visible benefit at 1:1 that survives an inspection designed not to favour it
next_experiments.why: closes the F3 versus F5 disagreement, which currently blocks the one enhancement the codebase already owns
next_experiments.upside: a defensible on-by-default setting at about 3% of the neural pass
next_experiments.downside: confirms the benefit is unreliable; sharpening stays off, which is the status quo
metrics: F3 metric set, reported but not decisive
next_experiments.success: visible benefit on a majority of textured regions with no region worse
next_experiments.failure: equivalent on a majority, or any region worse

next_experiments.title: denoise for Standard mode
next_experiments.hypothesis: a noisy photograph in Standard can be improved without a denoise pair, by routing to Creative at 0.25 rather than by filtering
next_experiments.why: Standard is the default mode and has no noise handling at all; the largest structural gap in the pipeline
next_experiments.downside: phase 3A already refuted fixed luma preprocessing; the arm must be routing, not filtering
next_experiments.corpus: existing five; only one noisy photograph, which is the limiting factor
metrics: reference-based scoring on the F5 degradation harness
next_experiments.success: visibly cleaner low-light with no skin or texture loss against Standard baseline
next_experiments.failure: any skin degradation, or no visible low-light gain
next_experiments.caveat: one noisy photograph is thin evidence for a default; reporting 'needs a broader corpus' is a legitimate outcome

next_experiments.title: tile 256 headroom on a loaded GPU
next_experiments.hypothesis: under realistic desktop GPU load, free VRAM falls below 2048 MB often enough that tile 128 is the common path
next_experiments.why: every F4 quality result assumes tile 256 was granted; if it usually is not, shipped quality is tile 128's
next_experiments.upside: either confirms the default is what users get, or shows the clamp threshold needs revisiting
next_experiments.success: a measured honoured-rate under load, or a documented reason to move the threshold
next_experiments.failure: cannot construct a realistic load; report the limitation
